expectedBehavior: AICockpit and diagnostic commands should either reach configured external backends under their approved execution context or clearly disclose the sandbox-specific network restriction before reporting a backend failure.
notes: Created after SP-043 activation investigation. This is an execution-environment capability gap, not a GitHub outage or repository credential failure.
observedBehavior: Commands executed inside the workspace sandbox fail DNS resolution for api.github.com (curl error 6), while the same request succeeds when granted escalated execution.
reproductionSteps: Run curl -sS -I https://api.github.com inside the workspace sandbox; observe DNS resolution failure. Repeat with escalated execution; observe HTTP 200.

workItem.title: Sandboxed commands cannot resolve external GitHub API DNS
